what.text: This page follows refugees from Rwanda living in Uganda, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 23244 Rwandan refugees in Uganda, 9.5% of all refugees from Rwanda.
The Democratic Republic of the Congo hosts the most Rwandan refugees, followed by Uganda, France and Malawi.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Rwanda from 1990 to 1994 and from 1996 to 2002, at war level in some of those years.
It also records armed conflict in later periods, with the FDLR-FOCA from 2022 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1961 at 52000 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 118000, at the end of 1985, and the main years of displacement in the data are 1964 to 1994.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Uganda.
These are year-end totals for Uganda only, reported to UNHCR.
